# Home runs

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarize(
		total_home_runs = sum(HR),
		total_team_games = sum(G),
		.groups = "drop"
	) |>
	mutate(
		home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
		season_type = if_else(
			yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
			"Shortened season",
			"Regular season"
		)
	)
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
	geom_line(color = "gray60") +
	geom_point(aes(color = season_type), size = 2) +
	scale_color_manual(
		values = c("Regular season" = "gray35", "Shortened season" = "firebrick")
	) +
	labs(
		title = "Home runs per game by season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs per game",
		color = "Season type",
		caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
	)
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |>
	filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
	mutate(
		season_order = match(yearID, c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020))
	) |>
	arrange(season_order) |>
	select(yearID, total_home_runs, total_team_games, home_runs_per_game) |>
	mutate(home_runs_per_game = round(home_runs_per_game, 2))
```
